patterns.note: Frequent use of architectural arch shapes as image masks and section transitions, reinforcing a classical, luxurious aesthetic.
High-contrast editorial serif headings paired with clean, widely-spaced sans-serif body copy and uppercase labels.
A warm, low-contrast palette dominated by soft cream backgrounds, muted gold accents, and deep charcoal text, avoiding harsh pure blacks.
A pinned scroll-sequence section ('EVERY DETAIL, A PLEASURE') where the central heading remains static while multiple arched images fade and slide into view around it as the user scrolls.
Full-bleed hero sections with a distinctive upward-curving arch mask at the bottom that smoothly transitions into the next content area.

technique_notes: To recreate the arched transition effect, use an SVG mask or CSS clip-path on the bottom of the hero container to create a smooth, upward-curving arch that reveals the cream-colored section below.

Implement the scroll-driven gallery using GSAP ScrollTrigger to pin the central heading container, while sequentially fading and translating absolute-positioned arched images into the viewport based on scroll progress.
Style the form inputs with a high border-radius and a semi-transparent white background to maintain a soft, integrated look over rich photographic backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body size) with generous line-height, paired with small, tracked-out sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded with a strong emphasis on arches; images and footer containers feature large, sweeping curves while buttons and inputs use a pill/subtle rounded shape.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and luxurious, utilizing massive vertical padding between sections to give the editorial layouts room to breathe.

standout: The integration of classical architectural arches as a recurring visual motif—from the hero transition masks and image frames to the pinned scroll-sequence gallery—creates an incredibly cohesive, high-end spa atmosphere.
